newsitem.title: BRAZIL: LatAm parliament condemns hostage taking in Peru.
newsitem.headline: LatAm parliament condemns hostage taking in Peru.

text.p: The Latin American Parliament condemned on Friday the taking of 400 hostages by leftist rebels in Peru as a violation of human rights and urged negotiations to resolve the crisis and safeguard the captives' lives.

The parliament said in a statement it "repudiates the act of terrorism by the Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement's (MRTA) which, by taking civilians hostage and using them as prisoners of war, represents the most flagrant violation of human rights."
It said it "fervently exhorts that all affects at dialogue and negotiation be exhausted to safeguard the lives of all the people unjustly held."
The body, based in Sao Paulo, represents the legislatures of 22 Latin American nations.
